name: llm_eligibility_alias_defaults
description: Managed guidance for safe aliases on user-managed eligibility facts.
lines: Return aliases only when they mean the same specific eligibility fact as the canonical wording.
Do not broaden a fact into a category, weaker claim, related skill, or general experience.
Prefer concise wording, common abbreviations, and exact synonymous forms.
Return an empty alias list when the wording is ambiguous or no safe alias is known.
Suggest a subtype only when the wording clearly supports it; otherwise return an empty subtype.
Return the aliases array and subtype only, in the same JSON object shape requested.
